structure_policy_rationale: Following the reference pattern of 'alipay' and 'douban', text-based logos in this theme are treated as solid 3D sculptures. The original flat vector paths of the '闲鱼' characters must be extruded into ice blocks without altering the font geometry, stroke connections, or spatial layout. The mascot (yellow fish) is excluded to maintain the minimalist 'ice sculpture on white background' composition rule established by the theme analysis.
preserve: The precise outline and internal negative space of the characters '闲' and '鱼'
The relative size and spacing between the two characters
The specific 'fish tail' shape of the bottom stroke in '鱼'
must_preserve: The exact stroke width and curvature of the '闲鱼' typography
The horizontal arrangement of the two characters
The distinctive underline stroke that mimics a fish tail or water wave
recompose_allowed: The thickness (Z-axis depth) of the characters can be exaggerated to enhance the 3D ice block effect
Internal details like bubbles or snowflakes can be embedded within the strokes
Edges should be rounded and smoothed to simulate melted ice, removing sharp vector corners
restyle: Convert black text color to translucent pale cyan ice material
Apply subsurface scattering and internal refraction to the character volume
Replace flat surfaces with glossy, wet ice texture featuring condensation droplets
decorate: Embed micro air bubbles and stylized snowflake patterns inside the ice volume
Add subtle caustic lighting effects through the translucent strokes
Include a small melting water puddle at the base of the text sculpture
forbid: Retaining the original yellow brand color or black text color
Including the yellow fish mascot in the composition
Creating a flat 2D blue text icon without volume or refraction
Distorting the font structure to the point of illegibility
Using opaque plastic or metal materials instead of translucent ice
generation_brief: 3D ice sculpture of Chinese text '闲鱼', translucent pale cyan crystal material, internal air bubbles and snowflakes, glossy wet surface with condensation droplets, rounded edges, soft studio lighting, pure white background, contact shadow and melting puddle at base, C4D render style, high fidelity, no mascot, no original colors.
color_application: Discard original black text and yellow brand colors entirely. Apply uniform pale cyan/ice blue hue with varying transparency based on thickness. Use cool grey for ambient occlusion shadows within the ice structure.
stroke_application: Eliminate 2D vector strokes. Transform character outlines into volumetric 3D forms with smooth, rounded, beveled edges resembling eroded ice. Define boundaries via light refraction and specular highlights rather than drawn lines.
composition_application: Center the '闲鱼' text sculpture on the canvas, occupying ~70% of the visual space. Ensure the text sits on a virtual ground plane with a subtle contact shadow. Exclude the fish mascot to maintain clean, single-subject composition consistent with theme rules.
identity_application: Preserve the exact geometric skeleton and legibility of the '闲鱼' logotype. Identity is maintained solely through the accurate 3D extrusion of the specific font shapes, particularly the 'fish tail' underline, while material and color are fully subordinated to the ice theme.
fidelity_constraints: Must use unified pale cyan translucent ice material, strictly no original brand colors
Must include internal bubbles, snowflakes, or ice cracks as core texture fingerprints
Subject must exhibit strong 3D volume with subsurface scattering, not a flat blue silhouette
Background must be clean pure white to highlight translucency
negative_constraints: No retention of original yellow or black colors
No inclusion of the fish mascot or other decorative elements
No flat 2D appearance; must have physical thickness and depth
No distortion of character strokes that compromises readability
No complex scene backgrounds; keep it minimalist
